gloss: breaking off (an engagement or deal); falling through

definitions.gloss: breaking off an engagement, deal, or negotiation; falling through
definitions.explanation: The collapse or cancellation of an agreed-upon arrangement, especially a marriage engagement or business deal. Composed of 破 (break) + 談 (talk/discussion). Implies that something that was being discussed or agreed upon has been called off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{婚約|こんやく}→婚約：02810_konyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{破談|はだん}になった。
⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わ→合う：10466_au⟧ず、⟦{商談|しょうだん}→商談：04877_shoudan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{破談|はだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: The terms didn't match, and the business negotiation fell through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{縁談|えんだん}→縁談：13847_endan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{破談|はだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A marriage proposal can fall through due to opposition from the other party's family.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always appears in the pattern {破談|はだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to fall through, to be called off). Most commonly associated with marriage arrangements (⟦{縁談|えんだん}→縁談：13847_endan⟧, ⟦{婚約|こんやく}→婚約：02810_konyaku⟧) but also used for business deals (⟦{商談|しょうだん}→商談：04877_shoudan⟧).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {破談|はだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to fall through)
- {破談|はだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to end in failure)
- {破談|はだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to call off — active)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{破局|はきょく}→破局：08373_hakyoku⟧ (breakup) refers to a romantic relationship ending, while {破談|はだん} specifically refers to a formal arrangement or negotiation collapsing before completion. ⟦{決裂|けつれつ}→決裂：14895_ketsuretsu⟧ (rupture/breakdown) is used for negotiations breaking down acrimoniously.
